notes.title: Corrupdate!
notes.content:
[h2]Corruption[/h2]

Two new tools, and a secret character, all of which employ a new mechanic: the corruption status effect for tools!

[h2]A Score of New Puzzles[/h2]

We've designed some puzzles and rooms we love too much to not add. 

[h2]Watercolor Mode[/h2]

You can now transform the game into a watercolor painting for a more cinematic experience.

[h2]Additional New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gold metacoins for big payouts
[*] Sprint speed settings
[*] Secret Stuff
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Daily mode is easier to unlock
[*] Updated gun description for enhanced clarity
[*] Made walls in the open world immune to bombs
[*] Tools can only be brought back to start world after a win
[*] Made it so you can put working buttons on walls in editor mode
[*] Updated the Unlock Condition descriptions to be more accurate
[*] Removed some less enjoyable solutions from drop pools
[*] Fixed some unreleased content showing up in the daily
[*] Fixed Xray Goggles' interaction with buried treasure
[*] Fixed lighting issues when loading saved runs
[*] Prevented bomb box from conducting after being destroyed
[*] Spring interaction with boxes improved
[*] Added some solutions, including for the room 'curvy_boi'
[*] Fixed bugs with random character starting a run as Francisco
[*] Turned 'a' to 'an' in death text if cause of death begins with a vowel
[*] Improved loading message changes
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes -- Conductive Boxes, Francisco, Lucky Penny, and more!
notes.content:
[h2]New Herman Content[/h2]
Our first new content for Herman Electro since Steam release! We're excited to bring you a character four years in the making, and some new tiles and puzzles to go along with it.

[h3] Francisco the Explorer, a New Character![/h3]

Francisco can passively see map layouts, find buried treasure, and convert 3 coins into a random super! He also can find supertools no other character can access.

[h3]Two New Boxes(that come with new puzzles!): Conductive Box and Power Box[/h3]

Boxes were a big success in early development, they offered another way to interact with puzzles without consuming tools. Conductive and Power boxes let you break or make circuits without spending tools, and sometimes pressure you to do so in order to pass them! Guards can push them too!

[h3]New Tool: Lucky Penny[/h3]

Lucky penny is a rare drop from crowned shop keepers, it's a coin with a chance not to be spent! You'll need to consider the odds, as you make decisions about whether to bet tools on your lucky penny putting in the work!

[h3]Minor bugfixes and art improvements[/h3]

We've been keeping up with YouTube content released by Herman players, as well as messages in the Herman Electro Discord, most notably by Lorgon111, and taking actions on the issues that show up!

[h2]Enjoy![/h2]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
Our first major patch! We're now wrapping up initial bug fixes, and preparing to polish additional content for release.

Tool Functionality
1. Coins can no longer be tossed in puddles (This was an old functionality we did not realize still existed)

Daily Runs
1. Disabled drops of two unreleased supertools in Daily Runs (Woodsplitter & Rising Stock)
2. Players can no longer get a headstart on dailies. (Movement in start world could transfer into daily.)

Secret Rooms
1. Secret room pool is now the intended pool, not the experimental pool.

Exploits
1. June can no longer reset her timer to 60 by saving and reloading.

Audio
1. Battering ram now trigger's tile's destruction sounds when destroying tiles.

Settings
1. Added experimental setting to show floor number.

Graphics
1. Fixed visual bug with spring, and one with entering some rooms.
2. Made some graphics code more efficient.

Messages
1. Revised some loading messages that were sub optimal.
2. Added exclamation mark to win message.
